rationale: With only 23 minutes to close, SHAZ is already at 90.3% of its intraday range near $23.34 after a massive intraday move from a low of $18.50 to a high of $23.86 — the risk/reward for chasing a long is poor given proximity to the high and end-of-day liquidation pressure. A short is equally unattractive: the last candle showed a strong uptick to $23.52 with elevated volume (24,937), price is above the 9-EMA ($23.18) and well above VWAP ($21.98), and the 60 bps spread adds meaningful friction. The combination of wide spread, late session timing, and unclear near-term directional edge makes skipping the prudent choice.
